overview_description.description:
Heroic Labs builds Nakama; an open-source distributed social and realtime server for games and apps. It includes a large set of services for users, data storage, and realtime client/server communication; as well as specialized APIs like realtime multiplayer, groups/guilds, and chat.
Heroic Labs is a Y Combinator company.

product.name: Nakama
product.description: An open-source game server framework for building social, multiplayer, and competitive game backends.

product.name: Hiro
product.description: A game development toolkit for rapidly building meta game features like economies, rewards, and analytics integration.

product.name: Satori
product.description: A LiveOps platform for managing player events, segmentation, feature flags, and experiments in games.

product.name: Heroic Cloud
product.description: A managed cloud service for deploying and scaling Nakama and Satori game backend clusters.

product.name: Nakama-Amazon GameLift Integration
product.description: An integration plugin combining Nakama's social matchmaking with Amazon GameLift's session-based multiplayer server management.
